method: Generated from approved Thirdpass reviews matching review_scope=target_file_full, agent_name=codex, agent_model=gpt-5.4-mini, agent_reasoning_effort=high. A crate version is emitted when the matching review records cover every regular file in the authoritative crates.io package archive manifest, measured by bytes, with zero pending and unreviewed manifest work.
